The '''S-1 Vamblade''' was a [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapon]] produced by [[Prax Arms/Legends|Prax Arms]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] and cost 500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. It was dagger-length blade extending from [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] [[Vambrace/Legends|vambrace]].<ref name="DC" />
